userStories.title: Shared todo-state fold library
userStories.description: As an Archon web developer, I want a pure tested todo-state projector (types, TODO_STATUS_PRESENTATION, projectTodoState, summarizeTodoState) in packages/web/src/lib/todo-state.ts, so that both node-room renderers share one renderer-free fold of Claude TodoWrite snapshots and OMP todo operations.
acceptanceCriteria: packages/web/src/lib/todo-state.test.ts is written FIRST and fails red before todo-state.ts exists; then the implementation turns it green via `cd packages/web && bun test src/lib/todo-state.test.ts`

Claude table passes: valid {todos:[...]} replaces state with one 'Tasks' phase verbatim (statuses preserved, activeForm dropped, no blocker leakage); later snapshot fully replaces earlier; todos:[] clears state; one malformed entry rejects the WHOLE call retaining prior state; two in-progress entries remain as supplied (no OMP normalization of Claude snapshots)

OMP table passes: at least one case per op (init/append/start/done/drop/block/unblock/rm/view); phased and flat init with default 'Tasks'; explicit empty list clears; flat-empty/missing init data rejects; append to existing and lazily-created new phase; task/phase/all-target forms for done and drop; all-target rm; exact matching; blocker whitespace collapsed; re-block updates reason; completed/abandoned not reopened; unblock only affects blocked; auto-promotion after every successful MUTATING op including promotion of an unnamed task; view leaves a deliberately non-normalized snapshot byte-for-byte unchanged

Missing-op inference is narrow and passes: non-empty list -> init; non-empty items + truthy string phase -> append; non-empty bare items -> init only when no phases exist; bare items on non-empty state is a no-op; everything else no-op

Batch/rollback passes: valid {ops:[...]} equals the same entries as separate ordered calls (normalize after each mutation); any invalid entry rejects the ENTIRE batch retaining pre-batch state; unknown operation, done-before-init, unknown target, duplicate init/append, missing block/unblock target, missing init data all retain prior state and do NOT normalize

Phase hygiene passes: removing the final item drops its phase; removing all returns []; return value contains fresh objects only (inputs deep-equal a saved copy after projection; repeat calls structurally equal with distinct identities); phase/task text preserved verbatim including provider-accepted empty strings; only blocker whitespace normalized
Robustness passes: mixed null/primitive/array/wrong-field-type/unknown-alias/plan-family-shaped inputs never throw and never invent state
Summary passes: completed-only count; representative precedence first in-progress > first blocked > last completed > first pending/abandoned > null; empty state returns current:null
TODO_STATUS_PRESENTATION contains all five statuses with contract glyph+label (completed ☑, in_progress ◐, blocked ⊘, pending ☐, abandoned ☐)
Implementation uses explicit type guards over unknown; no Zod and no provider-package imports in todo-state.ts; no runtime/dependency on the ambient OMP package

acceptanceCriteria: agent-history.ts exports `interface AgentHistory { items: AgentHistoryItem[]; todos: TodoPhase[] }` and buildAgentHistory returns it; the existing row projection is untouched

todo inputs are collected only from tool items whose resolved presentation.family === 'todo' (see tool-presentation.ts:138-140), in projected seq order even when source rows arrive unsorted; no provider/tool-name branching; no result-outcome filtering (running and interrupted todo rows still contribute their input)

All production callers compile against the new shape: NodeTranscriptPane.tsx and ConsoleNodeRoom.tsx retain { items, todos } for US-004; ConsoleExecutionHistory.tsx destructures ONLY items
Test helpers in LegacyNodeRoom.test.tsx and ConsoleNodeRoom.test.tsx adapted to return .items; all other existing unit callers adapted

userStories.title: Legacy + Console strip renderers
userStories.description: As an operator, I want the folded todo state rendered as an identical collapsible pinned strip at the top of both node rooms — with Legacy's room landmark corrected so strip and scroller are siblings inside one region — so that current todo state stays visible while the transcript scrolls.
acceptanceCriteria: packages/web/src/components/workflows/TodoStrip.tsx and packages/web/src/experiments/console/components/ConsoleTodoStrip.tsx created with identical semantics/anatomy: {phases: readonly TodoPhase[]} props, return null for [], useState(false) collapsed, useId() aria-controls body id, body stays in DOM with hidden={!open}, summarizeTodoState + TODO_STATUS_PRESENTATION for glyph/label only; differ only in existing surface token classes (in_progress Legacy --accent-bright / Console --running; focus offsets −2/+2); Console imports from @/lib/todo-state only, never @/components/

Markup matches the strip contract in prd.md and phase-02 (section aria-label Todo, flex-none, full-bleed, surface-elevated, 1px bottom rule, no radius; button 6/10 padding, ≥24px target, 8px gaps; TODO label 10px/700/uppercase/0.07em; representative item 11.5px mono elided; meter 3px cells 2px gaps aria-hidden with one cell per item; done/total 10px mono; ▾ caret 9px rotating 180° over 120ms, motion-reduce:transition-none; body 4/10/8 padding, top border, max-height 168px, overflow-y auto; h3 phase headings 10px/0.07em/4px top margin; item rows 11.5px mono lh 1.85; current row surface bg + text-primary + 2px inset running marker; blocked '· blocked: <reason>' visible; abandoned struck '· dropped'; visible suffixes aria-hidden when equivalent visually-hidden status phrase supplied; data-testid only 'todo-meter'/'todo-list'; agent strings render only as React text — never in id/aria-label/title/class)

userStories.title: Real-run visual/a11y evidence + PR
userStories.description: As a reviewer, I want the strip proven end-to-end on a real stored workflow run — pinning geometry, internal scroll, design anatomy, responsive/zoom, keyboard/focus/motion, contrast, and AX-tree evidence — recorded in an honest acceptance report with all gates green and a correctly formed PR, so that Story 1.5 can close.
acceptanceCriteria: agent-todo-strip.spec.ts extended (helpers file-local; agent-tool-row-visual.spec.ts untouched) running Phase-2 behavior cases on Chromium for both surfaces against the e2e-todo-strip run

Pinning proven geometrically: strip + transcript-scroller boxes and initial scrollTop captured; after scrolling transcript to settled bottom, first/last visible transcript rows changed while strip top/left/width/height within 1px; repeated after scroll back to zero; strip does not overlap transcript viewport or Jump button (toBeInViewport alone insufficient)

Internal scroll proven: expanded 12-item body computed max-height 168px + overflow-y auto + scrollHeight > clientHeight; scrolling body to bottom reveals final item while transcript scrollTop and strip container box unchanged

Geometry evidence at measured 460±2px room width both surfaces per the phase-03 table (container full-width/flex-none/surface-elevated/no-radius/1px bottom rule; header one line, 6/10 padding, ≥24px target, 8px gaps, surface-hover; label 10px/700/uppercase/0.07em; summary 11.5px mono elided with fixed glyph; meter 12 cells 3px high 2px gap status tokens aria-hidden; count 10px, caret 9px 0°/180°; body 4/10/8 padding top rule 168px cap real overflow; phase 10px/0.07em/4px top; item 11.5px/1.85; current row surface bg + 2px inset running marker)

Screenshots captured under plans/260918-0826-issue-178-pinned-todo-strip/reports/evidence/: legacy-todo-collapsed-460.png, legacy-todo-expanded-460.png, console-todo-collapsed-460.png, console-todo-expanded-460.png, one scrolled-room image per surface, todo-strip-metrics.json (geometry, overflow, token colors, ratios) — synthetic strings only

Responsive matrix both surfaces at 1440×1000, 1024×900, 768×900, 390×844, and Chromium 200% zoom: header one line with elision before count/caret loss; section/body within room; scrollWidth <= clientWidth; page overflow ≤1px; targets ≥24×24px; expand/collapse never covers transcript first row; internal body scroll usable at narrowest

Keyboard/focus/motion per surface: Todo header first focusable control in room region, no hidden body child in tab order while collapsed; Enter opens / Space closes / click toggles with focus retained; focus outline 2px solid opaque --accent-bright with Legacy −2px / Console +2px offset and the full-bleed Console outline visible on all four sides (no silent switch to −2px); caret transition 120ms normal motion, transition-property none under prefers-reduced-motion (do not require authored duration to become 0s); same-scope live update preserves focus+expansion; scope navigation mounts new collapsed control

Manual AT attempted: one Windows+NVDA+Chromium and one macOS+VoiceOver+Safari/Chromium pairing recorded; if an environment is unavailable the report marks manual AT sign-off BLOCKED rather than claiming a pass
